question_text: A data encoder made 8 errors in a 400-entry form. What is the error rate?

hint_ladder.title: Orient: Hanapin ang Fraction
hint_ladder.text: Tanong ay error rate, ibig sabihin anong porsyento ng entries ang may error. Hanapin ang fraction: errors / total entries.

hint_ladder.title: Rule: Formula ng Porsyento
hint_ladder.text: Formula: Rate = (part ÷ whole) × 100%. Parang diskwento sa tindahan, hinahanap ang part per hundred.

hint_ladder.title: Apply: Isaksak ang Numbers
hint_ladder.text: I-compute: 8 errors ÷ 400 entries = 0.02. Multiply by 100%: 0.02 × 100% = 2%. Kaya 2% ang error rate.

hint_ladder.title: Nearly There: Piliin ang Sagot
hint_ladder.text: 2% ang sagot. Check mo: 2% ng 400 ay 8. Kaya option B ang tama. Sure na sure!

A.text: You might have chosen A because you mistakenly moved the decimal, getting 0.01 instead of 0.02. 1% of 400 is just 4 errors.

C.text: You might have chosen C because you added 1% to 2% by mistake. 3% of 400 is 12, not 8.

D.text: You might have chosen D because you misapplied 8 as 4% of 400 without dividing properly. 4% of 400 is 16 errors.

next_time_rule: Mental trick: Rate = (part ÷ whole) × 100. Parang discount sa palengke: fraction, times 100 para percentage.
deconstruct_text:
Isipin mo nag-eencode ka ng birth certificates sa Barangay Hall. May 400 records, 8 ang may maling spelling ng pangalan.

Para malaman ang error rate, kunin mo fraction ng errors sa total: 8/400 = 0.02.

Multiply by 100% para maging porsyento: 2%. Check: 2% ng 400 ay 8. Kaya B.

Sa exam, laging tandaan: rate = (part ÷ total) × 100%, parang pagkuha ng suki discount sa palengke.
